y-m-13-11.title: Ukuba sikhulisa ikwere, kwenzeka ntoni kumjikelezo nakwindawo?
y-m-13-11.topic: Ubudlelwane bokuba umphetho wekwere nomjikelezo wayo nendawo yayo zitshintsha njani
y-m-13-11.goal: Phanda ngemizekelo emininzi ukuba umjikelezo nendawo ziba nokuphindwe kangakanani xa umphetho uba nokuphindwe okuthile, ufumane umthetho phakathi kokuphindwe komphetho nokuphindwe kwendawo, uze ucacise isizathu.
y-m-13-11.material: UDoyun wathi, 'Ukuba uphinda kabini umphetho omnye wekwere, umjikelezo uphindwa kabini yaye indawo iphindwa kabini nayo.' Apha, ikwere inobude bomphetho olulonani lemvelo le-cm, yaye iyunithi yendawo ziisentimitha ezikwere (cm²).
y-m-13-11.s.s1.prompt: Ikwere enomphetho we-3cm yakhuliswa ukuze umphetho ube yi-6cm. Umjikelezo nendawo zibe nokuphindwe kangakanani kokuqala nganye?
y-m-13-11.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana umjikelezo nendawo yomphetho we-3cm nowomphetho we-6cm uze uzibhale etafileni.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.hint.1: Beka amaxabiso okuqala namaxabiso emva kokukhula ecaleni kwenye uze ufumane ukuba aba nokuphindwe kangakanani.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.a: Umjikelezo ngokuphindwe ka-2, indawo ngokuphindwe ka-4
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.a: Uqinisekise ngokubala ukuba xa umphetho uphindwa kabini, umjikelezo nendawo zitshintsha ngokuphindwe okwahlukileyo.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.b: Umjikelezo ngokuphindwe ka-2, indawo ngokuphindwe ka-2 nayo
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.b: Oku kuyafana namazwi kaDoyun. Fumana indawo yokuqala 3×3 nendawo emva kokukhula 6×6 wena uze uzithelekise.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.c: Umjikelezo ngokuphindwe ka-4, indawo ngokuphindwe ka-4
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.c: Umjikelezo sisiphumo sokudibanisa ubude bemiphetho emine. Fumana ukuba umjikelezo wokuqala we-12cm uba zi-cm ezingaphi emva kokukhula.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.d: Umjikelezo ngokuphindwe ka-2, indawo ngokuphindwe ka-3
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.d: Indawo ifunyanwa ngokuphindaphinda ubude nobubanzi. Jonga oko kwenzeka kubude nobubanzi xa umphetho uphindwa kabini.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.explain: Xa umphetho ungu-3cm, umjikelezo ungu-12cm yaye indawo ingu-9cm², yaye xa umphetho ungu-6cm, umjikelezo ungu-24cm yaye indawo ingu-36cm². Umjikelezo ungokuphindwe ka-2, kodwa indawo ingokuphindwe ka-4. Elithi 'indawo iphindwa kabini nayo' likaDoyun alilunganga kulo mzekelo.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.prompt: Indawo yekwere ekhuliswe umphetho wayo ukuya kuphindwe ka-k kokuqala iba kuphindwe ka-m kwindawo yokuqala. (k linani lemvelo ukusuka ku-2 ukuya kwi-10.) Faka izibini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo ezilungileyo (k, m). Unokuhlola nangokufumana indawo yekwere wena.

y-m-13-03.topic: Ukubala okuxubileyo ngamanani endalo: iibhrakethi nolandelelwano lokubala
y-m-13-03.goal: Vavanya isibakala esithi 'ukufaka iibhrakethi kusoloko kutshintsha', fumana umzekelo ochasayo ngokwakho, uze uchaze imeko apho isiphumo singatshintshi khona.
y-m-13-03.material: UJiho wathi, 'Ukuba ufaka iibhrakethi kwisivakalisi sokubala, isiphumo sisoloko sitshintsha.' USua waphendula, 'Ngaba kunjalo ngenene ngalo lonke ixesha? Ndicinga ukuba zikho iimeko apho singatshintshi.' Aba bobabini bagqiba ekubeni bathelekise iintetho ezimbini besebenzisa amanani amathathu a, b, c. Intetho ㉮ yi-a + b × c (a yongeza b ngokuphindaphinda c), kwaye intetho ㉯ yi-(a + b) × c (qala ubale a yongeza b, uze uphindaphinde ngo-c). Onke la manani mathathu ngamanani endalo angama-1 okanye ngaphezulu, kwaye alandela isivumelwano sokuba ukuphindaphinda kubalwa phambi kokongeza.
